docs.q: how do i change the wallpaper
docs.a: Open Settings, or press the wallpaper chip in Control Center. Wallpapers here are original gradients, not Apple photos.

docs.q: install an app from the gallery
docs.a: Open Gallery and press Get. The app is added to the dock and opens. This is a local mock catalog, not a real store.
In this mock, liquid glass is frosted blur, a soft rim light, and a moving highlight on the dock, menu bar, and windows.
This is Lumen, a fan desktop for entertainment. It is not macOS, not Siri, and not Apple Intelligence.

docs.q: how do I lock the screen
docs.a: Press Control or Command L, or choose Lock from the round menu.
Press Control or Command K for search, or F4 for Launchpad.
